Latent block effects per coordinate

Source: R/latent_effects.R
latent_effects.Rd

The posterior of one latent() block (tgmrf(), tgmrf_cpp()) of a nested-Laplace fit, one row per coordinate of the block: each outer cell contributes the coordinate's conditional mean and marginal variance under the cell's latent Gaussian, and the rows are the exact mean, SD and 2.5% / 97.5% quantiles of that Gaussian mixture over the cell weights. Each coordinate's value is its contribution to the linear predictor of the observations obs_idx maps to it.

Usage

latent_effects(object, block = 1L)

Arguments

object

A nested-Laplace tulpa_fit carrying at least one latent() block.

block

Which latent block: its position among the fit's latent() blocks (default 1), or the name given to tgmrf().

Value

A data frame with one row per coordinate: index, estimate, sd, conf.low, conf.high and source ("mixture", or "mode" where the fit retained no per-cell variance).

See also

field_effects() for a spatial field, ranef() for random effects, temporal() for a temporal field.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
K <- 12
W <- matrix(0, K, K)
for (i in 1:K) { j <- if (i < K) i + 1 else 1; W[i, j] <- W[j, i] <- 1 }
d <- data.frame(region = rep(1:K, each = 10), x = rnorm(120))
d$y <- rpois(120, exp(0.5 + 0.4 * d$x + sin(2 * pi * d$region / K)))
blk <- tgmrf(Q = function(theta) Matrix::Diagonal(120, exp(theta[1])),
             prior = function(theta) dnorm(theta[1], 2, 1.5, log = TRUE),
             init = c(log_tau = 2), bounds = list(lower = -1, upper = 7),
             obs_idx = seq_len(120), name = "obs_iid")
fit <- tulpa(y ~ x + spatial(region) + latent(blk), data = d,
             family = "poisson", spatial = list(type = "icar", adjacency = W),
             mode = "auto", control = list(progress = FALSE))
head(latent_effects(fit, "obs_iid"))
#>   index      estimate        sd   conf.low conf.high  source
#> 1     1 -0.0406908127 0.2022865 -0.4873533 0.3498855 mixture
#> 2     2  0.0070854950 0.1946794 -0.3920110 0.4154124 mixture
#> 3     3  0.0834161171 0.2079128 -0.2871426 0.5647573 mixture
#> 4     4 -0.0658436023 0.1944762 -0.5028362 0.2950211 mixture
#> 5     5  0.0007732515 0.1939808 -0.4008558 0.4035905 mixture
#> 6     6 -0.0350130729 0.2023950 -0.4787040 0.3599066 mixture
# }
